---
title: "Benchmark report"
engine: knitr
---

```{r}
#| results: asis
source("lidarbench_report.R")
lb_banner()
created <- lb_meta("campaign_created_at")
if (length(created) && !is.na(created)) {
  cat("- Campaign created: ", created, "\n", sep = "")
  cat("- Full identity: `", lb_meta("identity_sha256"), "`\n", sep = "")
  description <- lb_meta("campaign_description")
  if (length(description) && !is.na(description)) cat("- Description: ", description, "\n", sep = "")
}
cat("- Report generated: ", lb_meta("generated_at"), "\n", sep = "")
cat("- Minimum timing: ", lb_meta("min_seconds"), " s (shorter timings are excluded and flagged)\n\n",
    sep = "")
for (note in lb_meta("note")) cat("> ", note, "\n\n", sep = "")
```

## Availability of measurements

One row per planned measurement unit (workload × dataset × CPUs × tool), including
units that were skipped, failed or never attempted.

```{r}
#| results: asis
summary <- lb_table("summary")
lb_kable(summary, c("workload", "dataset", "cpus", "tool", "tool_version", "section",
                    "evidence", "n_planned", "n_included", "n_missing", "median_seconds",
                    "availability"))
lb_download("summary")
```

## Reading this report

This report is derived only from the immutable records of one campaign
(`attempts/*/result.json`, verified through their receipts) and, optionally,
read-only historical R results. Nothing was re-run and no record was changed.

**Selection.** For each schedule entry the latest attempt (start sequence) is
used; a failed final retry never falls back to an earlier success. Warm-ups and
superseded retries are kept in the [attempt ledger](tables/attempts.csv) but never
contribute samples.

**Evidence tiers** of an included measurement:

```{r}
#| results: asis
meta <- lb_table("report_meta")
tiers <- meta[startsWith(meta$key, "tier:"), , drop = FALSE]
tiers$tier <- sub("^tier:", "", tiers$key)
lb_kable(data.frame(tier = tiers$tier, meaning = tiers$value))
```

A *validated* report includes only `validated` and `accepted_exception`
measurements; a *performance-only* report also includes `unverified` and
`execution_only` measurements, labelled as such. Failed or incomplete validation
is never included.

**Timing.** Times are the outer fresh-process interval measured by the
orchestrator (`timing_boundary = process`), including interpreter and package
start-up. Tool-reported inner intervals are shown separately and never mixed.
Caches are uncontrolled (warm-cache behaviour).

**Variability.** Every repetition is shown. Summaries give mean, sample SD
(n − 1), coefficient of variation, median, quartiles and range; fewer than two
samples give an empty SD, never zero.

**Comparisons.** Cross-tool ratios appear only on the
[validated comparisons](comparisons.qmd) page and only when the comparability
gate passed (validated report, comparable attempts, same contract, dataset,
campaign identity, timing boundary and run dimensions). All other timings are
descriptive. CPU scaling is reported within one tool only.
